title: Use the Monitoring Console to Investigate Health
objectives: Use the Monitoring Console to Investigate Health
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture has three recorded ops_logs events and a stopped idx02. In Monitoring Console home, expand V7 operational evidence and inspect the actual services. Compare this with the virtual idx02 service and cluster views.

Start the idx02 Splunk service from its virtual terminal. Capture fresh platform evidence in Monitoring Console and verify the service is running. Search index=ops_logs | stats count and distinguish actual recorded-data evidence from generated baseline graphs.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
